rationale: Material prompt requirement: An asset owner is preparing year-end statements after granting a customer access to specialised equipment. Source anchor "## ACCOUNTING — AAOIFI FAS 4 (BAHRAIN, QATAR)": Addresses a co-ownership arrangement with rental income and customer buy-outs, but treats a diminishing musharaka investment rather than the requested asset-owner lease classification, depreciation basis and disclosure analysis.. On that source-visible basis, the source is a meaningful neighbouring route but misses the stated boundary Boundary noted in the sealed assessment: Assess the customer-access arrangement as a lease, account for the owned asset and distinguish useful life from the access duration..
